headline: Sanathan Textiles Limited Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Sanathan Textiles Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4), indicating a substantial acquisition of shares and/or control triggering takeover code obligations.
detail: The filing represents a structured disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating the target has received notice of a substantial shareholding acquisition crossing mandatory thresholds. Regulation 31(4) requires the target company to immediately notify the exchange and publish details of the acquirer's identity, shareholding pattern, and acquisition structure. The disclosure obligation arises where an acquirer crosses 25% or enters into negotiations or agreements for control.
